blocks.text: A useful backup is a separate copy that you have checked you can restore. Include documents, relevant application data and private configuration. Protect encrypted backups and keep recovery keys separately.

items: Identify the source and destination carefully. Check available space.
Close applications with databases or use their documented export/backup operation.
Keep at least one copy outside the computer.
Verify representative restored files in a safe destination.
Close files and use the owning unmount/eject action before unplugging media.

blocks.text: Timeshift snapshots focus on system recovery and do not replace a user-data backup. Two-way synchronization can propagate deletion or corruption. NFS/Filen access is not proof that a separate backup exists.
Restore operations can overwrite newer data. Preserve a copy of the current state and confirm the exact destination before restoring.
